responsibility: Defines AArch64 and Arm64EC inline-assembly register classes and registers, including register aliases, legal type support, modifier rendering, and target-dependent validation such as reserved x18 and Arm64EC-specific register exclusions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/aarch64.rs`, this AArch64 file defines the inline `asm!` register model—classes, aliases, modifiers, overlaps, and target-specific register bans like reserved `x18` or Arm64EC exclusions—rather than function-call ABI passing rules.
